opening.argument: The presentation leads with a concrete promise: viewers are told how to get “$50 to Spend at Taco Bell,” while the description directs them to an offer site. The video repeats that direction on screen, moving viewers from the promised benefit to an external link. It then changes the apparent offer into a request to enter personal information “for a chance to win,” meaning the benefit is not presented as guaranteed. No terms are provided to reconcile the initial $50 claim with this chance-based entry. The combination of a low-barrier reward promise, repeated link instructions, and information submission for only a possibility of winning supports the conclusion that the offer is deceptive.
